title: Data in Nuxt: useFetch, useAsyncData and the payload that crosses over

videos.script:
Every page of the Nuxt planner starts with one line, await useFetch. Today that line is taken apart. {{fetch}} First, where the request is actually made. You will add a line to the server that reports every request to the API, and find that the browser asks for nothing the server already fetched.

{{async}} Then useAsyncData, the general form, for data that is not one URL. {{payload}} Then the payload, the data the server writes into the page for the browser to read, and the rule that comes with it. Anything in the payload is public.

{{double}} Then the mistake everybody makes once, a fetch that runs on the server and again in the browser. {{keys}} Then keys, the name the data goes by, and a page where two calls share a name and one of them gets the other's data.

{{errors}} Then a server that fails, and a page that says so instead of showing an empty week. {{lazy}} And last, lazy fetching, and what a page should show while it waits.
